notes: This slot's other attestation (Hos.11.7, תְלוּאִים, "my people are bent to backsliding from me") leans toward the lexicon's more idiomatic third sense ("habituate", of mental dependence) rather than literal/figurative "hang" -- Deut.28.66 ("thy life shall hang in doubt before thee") was kept as the representative citation since it matches the requested gloss directly.
